svg.text: ZX Spectrum 128K · 64 KB address space of the Z80 · eight 16 KB RAM banks, paged in at C000 through port 7FFD · build 0.16
Free: core 90 B · bank 0 1.2 KB · bank 4 402 B · bank 6 62 B · bank 3 509 B. Every paged bank keeps the IM2 vector table and JP isr at FDFD; calls between banks go through BCALL in the fixed code.
